finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is declared as source metadata in SKILL.md and does not trigger any network request. No executable code or data transmission path is present.
The URL is a documentation link to the upstream repository. It is not used for fetching, exfiltration, or runtime behavior.

content.user_title: Create AI PowerPoint Decks from Documents
content.value_statement: Turning documents into clear presentations can take careful planning and visual direction. This skill guides AI-assisted PPT creation with document analysis and styled image planning.
actual_capabilities: Provides guidance for AI-powered PPT generation workflows.
Frames presentation creation around document analysis.
Includes styled image planning as part of presentation output.
Explains when to use the skill for presentation tasks.
Links to the upstream source repository for more context.
limitations: This skill is prompt guidance, so it does not run document parsing, image generation, or PPT export by itself.
The local skill file does not include slide templates or example decks.
Results depend on the host AI tool and the files supplied by the user.
The source repository link is informational and may require separate review.

use_cases.title: Convert Reports into Decks
use_cases.description: Turn a long report into a concise presentation outline with slide themes and visual directions.

use_cases.title: Plan Visual Presentation Assets
use_cases.description: Create prompts for styled images that support key points in a PowerPoint deck.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Briefings
use_cases.description: Analyze source material and organize it into a clear deck structure for stakeholder review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Deck Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short presentation plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nanobanana-ppt-skills to turn this document into a 6-slide PowerPoint outline. Include slide titles, key points, and suggested visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Styled Presentation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with tone and image direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nanobanana-ppt-skills to analyze this source text and design a 10-slide deck. Use a professional tone and include styled image prompts for each section.

prompt_templates.title: Restructure a Dense Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for synthesis and audience focus.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nanobanana-ppt-skills to convert this detailed document into an executive briefing. Prioritize key insights, remove repetition, and propose visual treatments.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Complete Deck Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a full production specification.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nanobanana-ppt-skills to create a full PPT production brief. Include slide sequence, speaker notes, image style, chart ideas, and review checkpoints.

output_examples.input: A product strategy document for a quarterly leadership meeting.
output: A 10-slide executive deck outline with one message per slide.
Suggested chart types for market, roadmap, and adoption sections.
Styled image directions that match a polished business presentation.

output_examples.input: A research summary that needs a classroom presentation.
output: A structured lesson deck with introduction, evidence, and conclusion slides.
Plain language bullet points based on the source material.
Visual suggestions for diagrams, timelines, and section dividers.

best_practices: Provide the source document and desired audience before asking for slides.
Specify slide count, tone, brand constraints, and image style.
Review generated slide plans for factual accuracy before building the deck.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a finished PPT file without supplying source content or requirements.
Do not treat image prompts as final approved artwork.
Do not skip human review for sensitive, legal, medical, or financial presentations.

faq.question: Does this skill generate PowerPoint files directly?
faq.answer: No. The local skill provides guidance for AI-assisted PPT planning and content generation.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What input works best?
faq.answer: Use a clear source document, target audience, slide count, tone, and visual style requirements.

faq.question: Does it include image generation prompts?
faq.answer: It describes styled images as part of the workflow, so users can request image direction.

faq.question: Is the repository link required for use?
faq.answer: No. The link is informational and points to the upstream source repository.

faq.question: What should I review before publishing a deck?
faq.answer: Check facts, source coverage, visual rights, brand alignment, and speaker notes before sharing.
